verdict.rationale: Lindy's Routines docs say you can 'set a schedule or trigger once, and Lindy runs the whole job for you on autopilot,' which covers the core of event-triggered automation. The evidence is a single repeated sentence, though, and gives no detail on what events can serve as triggers or how a user would write conditional rules; the built-in automatic inbox triage is a vendor-defined behavior, not a user-defined rule. Missing for 10: documented list of trigger/event types, user-defined rule/condition logic, examples of event-to-action configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
